_source: Live keyless POST https://agenttax.io/api/v1/calculate 2026-11-04 {role:seller, amount:100, buyer_state:WA, transaction_type:saas} (track_payment shape). Verbatim except upgrade.signup.body.agent_name.

location.detail: No buyer_zip was sent, so only the Washington state rate was used.

nexus.detail: No nexus is set for Washington, so sales tax defaulted to zero and tax_if_nexus shows the figure with nexus.

taxability.detail: Washington treats digital services as taxable under its category rule.

response.disclaimer: This calculation is informational only and does not constitute tax advice. Consult a qualified tax professional for compliance decisions.

upgrade.message: Demo mode returns simplified results. Create a free account for full audit trails, jurisdiction details, advisories, transaction history, and nexus monitoring.

signup.then: Add header X-API-Key: <your_key> to all requests

upgrade.free_tier: 1,500 calls/mo at $0 — full response data, persistent state

tax_if_nexus.basis: Hypothetical: what this transaction owes if you have nexus in Washington. Not applied to total_tax.

nexus_note.advisory: Demo mode has no nexus profile for WA, so this seller-side call defaulted to no collection obligation and returned $0.00. This is a default, not a determination — it is not a finding that you owe nothing in WA. tax_if_nexus is what this transaction owes once nexus is set.

fix.note: Create a free account to configure your own nexus states and get the determination instead of the default.
